distinguishing_features: Directly damps a machine-tool spindle structural chatter mode rather than monitoring or predicting a failure indicator.
Generates damping from inertia of an oscillating pressurized coolant column in an isolated reservoir instead of a solid mass or oil-film viscosity effect.
Integrates the damping circuit into the existing coolant supply/return loop with an accumulator, orifice, and solenoid diversion.
Uses spindle load current and commissioning/tool data to tune and trigger damping at a target chatter frequency.
